errors.text_span: The MATTER (ours) series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers, starting near 55.1% at 0.5 tokens, dipping slightly around 54.3–54.5% at 0.6–0.7, rising to about 57.0% at 0.8 and reaching its highest point near 57.9% at 1.0, then declining through about 55.4% (1.1) and ~53.0% (1.2) to ~52.6% (1.3), increasing to ~53.5% at 1.4, and ending near 50.9% at 1.5. The “w/o material information” series is shown as a solid purple line with circular markers, beginning around 52.5% at 0.5, increasing to about 54.1% at 0.7, then staying near 52.8–53.3% from roughly 0.8 through 1.2 (e.g., ~53.3% at 0.8–0.9 and ~52.4% at 1.2), dipping to about 51.7% at 1.3, rising to ~53.3% at 1.4, and then dropping to approximately 47.9% at 1.5.
errors.evidence: The description lists the approximate coordinates for every single data point on both lines. This level of detail is excessive and makes the description difficult to read and understand, functioning more like a data table than a summary of the chart's visual trends.

The description states that for the 'w/o material information' series, the score stays in the range of 52.8-53.3% for x-values from 0.8 to 1.2. However, the data points at x=1.1 (~52.7%) and x=1.2 (~52.4%) are below this range. The correct range for these points is approximately [52.4, 53.3].
For the MATTER series, the value at x=1.2 is approximately 52.7%, not 53.0% as stated. The point is visibly closer to 52.5 than 53.
